description: BFREE is a specialist investor in distressed retail and SME debt across Africa. The company acquires non-performing unsecured retail and SME loan portfolios, recovering them through an ethical, technology-driven platform that ensures fair borrower treatment. For lending partners, this means freed-up provisions, released capital, and improved return on equity while having a scalable and ethical solution to solve NPLs. With 35+ transactions and 11 million customers managed across the continent, the company is now exploring the Egyptian market and keen to engage with local lenders on NPL portfolio sales.
tagline: BFREE is focusing on providing support for financial services by offering relevant tech solutions and risk management tools that will aid their customers to achieve full financial health.

description: Blnk is a fintech company with a mission of enabling inclusion through point-of-sale financing. Less than 6% of Egyptians have access to credit cards and can only afford to purchase products/services with cash that they have saved or are forced to borrow from hard money lenders at high interest rates. Blnk is changing this by enabling all consumers to instantly receive credit within minutes at their favorite merchants.
tagline: Enabling inclusion through point-of-sale financing

description: Cartona is a B2B platform connecting buyers and sellers. Cartona enables buyers to order inventory by providing an easy-to-use mobile application that allows them to access a network of curated sellers. Cartona has introduced embedded financing which is seamlessly integrated into ordering cycles. The platform additionally offers detailed market insights on buyer behaviour, price competition and market share.
tagline: Cartona is a B2B platform connecting buyers (retailers) and sellers (producers, distributors and wholesalers)

description: Connect Money is a leading provider of embedded finance solutions, offering a one-stop shop banking experience for businesses and cash users. With a proven track record of over 300K issued cards, Connect Money enables secure and reliable cashless payments, lending services, rewards programs, and a comprehensive range of financial solutions.
tagline: Connect Money is a leading provider of embedded finance solutions, offering a one-stop shop banking experience for businesses and cash users

description: DeepEcho is an AI first healthtech company with FDA clearance founded by AI and healthcare experts. DeepEcho is on a mission to revolutionize prenatal care by providing clinicians with powerful, accessible tools to enhance fetal ultrasound diagnostics. Leveraging one of the world’s largest fetal ultrasound datasets and state-of-the-art deep learning techniques, DeepEcho is shaping the future of maternal-fetal health to ensure better outcomes for pregnant mothers globally.
tagline: An AI healthtech company with FDA clearance revolutionizing maternal and fetal health

description: With more than 50 enterprise clients and 1700 brands across 7 countries in EMEA region, Dsquares provides customized end to end loyalty and rewards’ solutions through a seamless customer experience and guaranteed results. Dsquares provides the technical, commercial and operational implementation and management for any loyalty program they manage.
tagline: Dsquares is Egypt’s leading provider of end to end loyalty programs and is expanding geographically and into B2C payments

description: DXwand stands at the forefront of AI technology specializing in generative AI, knowledge mining and omnichannel Conversational AI technologies. DXwand empowers businesses to analyze data, govern compliance, optimize efficiency, generate documents, and engage customers across various channels, supporting multiple languages, including Arabic dialects.
tagline: DXwand stands at the forefront of AI technology specializing in generative AI, knowledge mining and omnichannel Conversational AI technologies
team: Mahmoud Gomaa – Co-founder & Chief Growth Officer

description: By uniquely blending interior design with technology, Efreshli has revolutionized the industry, ensuring that elevated design is attainable regardless of style or budget. The company has developed a strong network of ecosystem players within the design and home space, facilitating interaction among stakeholders to drive innovation in architecture as a whole. The platform showcases and sells thousands of products from over 150 of Egypt’s top brands, creating a seamless home shopping experience for its customers.
tagline: Efreshli is built on a mission to make interior design accessible to everyone

description: Millions of people around the world ask the same question everyday “What will I eat today?” It’s the question that triggered the journey to build elmenus. elmenus is an Egypt based company that started in 2011 with the vision to help people decide what to eat. We are building a platform that combines a social, visual and personalized experience to help people discover and order the food they love.
tagline: Elmenus is Egypt’s #1 food destination and fastest growing food ordering and delivery platform

description: Founded by a team of seasoned payments industry experts, enza is committed to delivering agile, innovative, and secure payment solutions designed specifically for Africa’s unique challenges. With headquarters in the UAE and operations across Egypt, Nigeria, South Africa, and other key markets, enza is helping banks and fintechs unlock new opportunities for growth and inclusion.
tagline: enza is on a mission to liberate payments and democratise the commercial possibilities for buyers and sellers across the continent

description: Eventtus is a leading event tech company that empowers the biggest conferences and exhibitions in 35 countries to create amazing event experiences using a powerful, robust and intuitive array of event tech solutions that proved, again and again, its top-notch quality and yielded happy customers everywhere. Through its innovative and adaptive approach, Eventtus offers solutions to both virtual and in-person events.
tagline: Eventtus is a virtual events platform where you can create an amazing digital events experience for all your audience, anywhere

description: Filkhedma is Egypt’s largest home services marketplace operating in 4 cities across cleaning, maintenance and beauty services. Filkhedma empowers service providers through technology to grow their incomes and develop professionally.
tagline: FilKhedma provides high quality reliable home services at preset prices and through background checked service providers

description: GoodsMart wants you to let go of your daily errands, enjoy daily fresh products and save money! Thus allowing you to have more quality time for yourself & with your loved ones. GoodsMart offers its clients access to order a wide variety of products covering almost everything their households need through its smart app and reliable daily delivery system of the orders while ensuring their safety through its innovative unattended delivery solutions.
tagline: GoodsMart is a smart and easy household shopping platform

description: Khazna was founded in April 2019 with a mission to improve the financial well-being of 20M+ underbanked Egyptians who have little access to formal financial services by providing access to convenient, effective and secure smartphone based financial services.
tagline: Khazna provide customer-centric and transparent financial services to the underserved in emerging markets through its disruptive platform

description: Egypt’s first online platform for fashion items rental. The e-commerce platform simply designed to provide a sophisticated connection between both, dress owners and renters. What makes La Reina stands out substantially is the way our services are easily delivered, from the user-friendly application to professional customer service, redeeming high quality fashion items and saving your time, money and effort.
tagline: Egypt's first online platform for fashion items rental

description: Little Thinking Minds creates subscription based educational resources and platforms aimed at improving learning outcomes, and enhancing children’s literacy and fluency skills, with an initial focus on the Arabic Language. They deliver digital Arabic apps (based on a SAAS model) with rich educational resources that are aligned with curriculum standards globally.
tagline: Leading MENA based ed-tech company that creates advanced digital solutions for school-aged children to improve outcomes

description: Lucky’s mission is to revolutionize the way the Middle East and North Africa shops, pays and saves. Founded in Egypt in 2018, Lucky has connected more than six million loyal customers with access to a growing range of easy-to-use credit products, discounts and cashback rewards that can be used in person and virtually with tens of thousands of local and global brands.
tagline: Lucky is Egypt's leading fintech app for consumer credit products, powered by market-leading cash-back rewards and a merchant network of more than 30,000 stores

description: Founded in 2016, Lyve is a community management platform and private social network that connects residents, real estate developers, and facility management all in a single, unified, extensible solution.
tagline: Egypt’s first real estate community platform

description: MNT-Halan, Egypt’s first unicorn, was founded in 2018 in Egypt, with a mission to revolutionize access to financial services through technology. Serving millions, MNT-Halan’s transformative digital platform improves lives by creating convenient, seamless, and cost-effective financial solutions for people and aspiring businesses. Committed to innovation and simplicity for everyday life, MNT-Halan believes financial access enables people to fulfill their dreams.
tagline: MNT-Halan is Egypt's largest and fastest growing lender to the unbanked and underbanked

description: Mozare3 is an agri-fintech startup that aims to be the agricultural arm of food processing companies, and the marketing &amp; financing arm of small-scale farmers. Mozare3 aims to generate deals to farmers with food processing companies, exporters, agricultural service providers and nurseries, to ensure a market opportunity to sell their crops, and to supply them with basic needs of the agricultural process from pesticides, fertilizers, Seedlings or Seeds through offering flexible payment terms.
tagline: Mozare3 is the farmer’s partner is digitizing agriculture in Egypt

description: Mtor is an online-to-offline business offering a one-stop platform to workshops to procure a comprehensive range of automotive spare parts on-demand, at competitive prices. Mtor uplifts workshops by providing faster delivery, cheaper prices and accurate data that streamlines the mechanic’s workflow.
tagline: Mtor is an online-to-offline business offering a one-stop platform to workshops to procure a comprehensive range of automotive spare parts on-demand, at competitive prices.
team: Mozz El Megharbel – Co-Founder & VP of Strategy

description: Octane is a digital wallet for vehicles that streamlines payments for all vehicle related expenses. It provides a comprehensive system that enhances fuel payment services. The system includes a controlled and monitoring fueling process that’s fraud free, digital and controlled. Octane has the widest stations network coverage in Egypt.
tagline: A digital payments solution to streamline all vehicle-related expenses in Egypt

description: oliv is a digital invoice financing company serving small and medium businesses in Egypt. Its service involves minimal manual interactions and no technology requirements from clients, and delivers funding in less than 48 hours. The company operates under a digital factoring license from the Egyptian Financial Regulatory Authority.
tagline: The simplest and fastest lending experience serving small and medium businesses in Egypt

description: Orcas is a learning platform for students that offers tutors, courses, assessments, and learning video content. All four learning environments are connected to lesson paths designed by Orcas’ education team. The activity and performance of the learners on the platform are captured in a report to help them optimize their learning experience around their needs and strengths.
tagline: Edtech company that helps connect learners with tutors, learning style assessments, personalized learning plans and gamified practice questions

description: POSRocket is a customer-centric restaurant management platform providing a full suite of services including the point of sale, e-payments, order management, kitchen management and delivery. We’re a growing team of experts that proved traction and excellence by serving 3500 business across the MENA & GCC and processing over 2Billion $ in transactions.
tagline: POSRocket provides next-gen POS solutions for small and medium F&B retailers

description: Sakneen is a YC-backed PropTech company based in Cairo. The company was launched in 2020 by Ramy Khorshed and Hussein El Kheshen with the vision of digitising the home buying experience in Egypt and empowering homebuyers with the tools & information they need to make the best real estate decision.
tagline: The easiest, fastest, and most enjoyable way to buy or sell a home in Egypt

description: Shift EV is an electric mobility technology startup based in Cairo, with technology that allows businesses to shift to electric mobility with a tailored solution at a fraction of the cost of a new EV. The technology stack starts with the core of EVs: we design and manufacture state of the art Lithium ion battery packs that integrate seamlessly with existing chassis and remotely connect fleet vehicles to ShiftWare, the fleet operating system, for full digital visibility and control.
tagline: Electrifying fleets in emerging markets using proprietary electrofitting™ technology

description: Sylndr is automotive focused e-commerce marketplace bringing innovation to the used-cars market, where customers can reliably and transparently sell and buy used cars. The company is building trust in the used-car market by becoming the go-to place for customers seeking to sell and buy their cars, through an extensive range of high-quality used vehicles accessible across a diverse set of financing solutions.
tagline: Sylndr is an automotive focused e-commerce marketplace bringing innovation to the used-cars market, where customers can reliably and transparently sell and buy used cars

description: Synapse Analytics helps financial institutions, fintechs, and telecom providers unlock growth opportunities by streamlining complex processes like credit decisioning, document automation, and risk management. From embedded financing to real-time data analytics, its platform is built to adapt, scale, and deliver results where it matters most.
tagline: Empowering financial innovation through AI

description: Trella connects shippers to carriers with the aim of creating transparency, efficiency and reliability, empowering carriers to find regular work with a multitude of shippers, eliminate excessive broker margins, and maximize utilization of their trucks, while allowing shippers to book affordable loads, minimize matching time, and have greater visibility/tracking on their shipments.
tagline: Trella is a regional trucking marketplace that connects shippers and carriers, making a highly fragmented market more efficient, reliable and convenient
team: Muhammad El Garem – Co-Founder & Head of Launch

description: Traveazy Group, which operates Umrahme and Holidayme, is a B2B travel tech company with a strong focus on the Umrah market. Traveazy digitalizes the Umrah ecosystem by providing agents a B2C experience in a B2B environment along with analytics, business intelligence & marketing capabilities.
tagline: Customized holiday packages for all customers across the Middle East.
team: Geet Bhalla – Co-Founder – Mohammed M.S Binmahfouz – Co-Founder

description: Yodawy is an online pharmacy and insurtech startup that allows customers to order pharmaceuticals and cosmetics via a mobile app and have those delivered through a network of 500+ pharmacies across Egypt. Insurance and copayment benefits are automatically applied with four major insurance carriers onboarded thus far and more in the pipeline.
tagline: Egypt’s largest online medication ordering and pharmacy benefits management platform

description: YoLa Fresh is on a mission to revolutionize the fresh produce game in Africa. The company is using cutting-edge tech to streamline the whole process of getting fruits and veggies from farm to plate. They are giving farmers and other players in the game more power and control than ever before. Plus, the supply chain is built to move thousands of tonnes of perishable goods every single day, in less than 24 hours.
tagline: YoLa Fresh is an agritech company building a sustainable and traceable fresh food supply network
